trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlock all other 54 trophies across the game to earn this platinum. It requires roughly 200 hours of playtime and covers story progression, 100% completion, collectibles, and side activities. Check your overall progress in the pause menu before starting cleanup in free roam.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening narrative sequence of Chapter 1 with Jason and Lucia. Simply follow mission markers and complete the objectives in Gone Fishing. This trophy is unmissable as it is part of the core story campaign.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all required main story missions making up Chapter 1 of the campaign. The trophy unlocks automatically upon the chapter's conclusion. Keep manual saves at chapter breaks for safety.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Progress through the narrative and finish all key story operations in Chapter 2. This unlocks automatically as you advance the plot in Leonida. Note that certain side activities open up during this chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete all main missions assigned throughout Chapter 3. The trophy pops when transitioning out of the chapter's final cinematic. Stay alert for optional partner encounters along the way.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Advance through the heavy heist preparation and execution stages of Chapter 4. Complete the final chapter assignment to unlock this story milestone. Bank vault operations become fully accessible around this timeframe.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Reach and successfully complete the grand finale of the GTA 6 campaign. Make sure your loadout and health reserves are prepared before triggering the final sequence. Unlocks immediately upon rolling credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play through and complete the 'Breakfast Run' story mission with Jason and Lucia. This narrative beat reinforces team dynamics early in the game. Follow waypoint instructions to finish without issues.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Execute and survive 'The Cartel Heist' main mission. Coordinate partner abilities during the getaway to evade high heat and secure the objective. Unlocks upon mission completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Progress the storyline by finishing the 'Child's Play' mission. Pay close attention to dialogue and unfolding family tensions between characters. The trophy pops when the mission debrief concludes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Headliners' story mission in Leonida. Follow the scripted action sequences and neutralize designated targets. Unlocks automatically as part of the campaign progression.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Participate in and finish the 'VCIA Takedown' story operation. Coordinate precision driving and timing with your partner during the intercept. The achievement unlocks upon mission wrap-up.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Survive and conclude 'Operation Savage Glory' during the later acts of the campaign. Manage combat encounters carefully in restricted zones. Unlocks as the mission cinematic plays out.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% game completion by finishing story missions, stranger strands, random events, vehicle collections, and activities. Track your exact percentage in the pause menu under Progress > Stats. Expect this comprehensive checklist grind to take around 100 hours after the main campaign.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Successfully land 250 stunt jumps scattered across Leonida. Use fast sports cars or motorcycles to clear gaps and ramps reliably. Keep count or consult an interactive map to track remaining jumps.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in all 9 distinct leisure and competitive activity types available throughout Leonida at least once. This includes shooting ranges, races, drone trials, fishing, and arcade games. Check off each variety in free roam.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Master all 42 Shooting Range challenges across gun shops and earn a gold medal rating in every single one. Focus on target accuracy, headshot multipliers, and quick reloading. Practice makes perfect for this demanding precision test.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Locate and win a Top Fun drone racing trial at all 14 designated spots in the state. Master nimble drone handling through tight checkpoints without crashing. Check your map markers for active race flags.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Place first in 20 unique racing events across Leonida's street and off-road circuits. Use upgraded vehicles suited to each terrain type for optimal cornering speed. Tracking your wins via the pause menu helps avoid duplicate tracks.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Engage NPC Cal in a lakeside fishing challenge and catch a heavier fish to win. Cast near lily pads or deep water and manage line tension carefully to reel the catch in. Unlocks upon securing victory against Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Visit any arcade cabinet or safehouse console and play through a complete session of an arcade mini-game until victory or completion. Simple arcade classics dotted around the map work perfectly for this.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Track down and complete all multi-part stranger missions given by Andy, culminating in his final chapter. Keep an eye out for character markers on your radar during free roam. Finishes Andy's dedicated questline.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Progress through all encounters with Kenton and wrap up his final aquatic stranger assignment. Travel to coastal docks where his missions initiate. Unlocks upon successfully concluding his storyline.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Fulfill all stranger tasks requested by Billy across the map until his concluding mission becomes available. Complete the final ride objective to earn this trophy. All major character side quests can be finished in free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and finish 8 complete multi-mission stranger strands across Leonida. Explore highway pull-offs, city alleys, and rural outposts to meet eccentric characters. Check your progress in the pause menu stats.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Help Randy through his series of smuggling and trade favors, ending with his final mission. Deliver the cargo securely to seal the deal. Unlocks upon completing his narrative arc.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Assist Tyrone through his urban hustle assignments until his final quest line triggers. Complete the closing objective successfully. Concludes Tyrone's side story arc.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit and complete meditation interactions at all 18 scenic spots across Leonida. Note that the Lucia balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 (available after 'Down to Earth') is missable if skipped during the story. All other meditation locations can be visited in free roam.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Meet hunter Bret in the wilderness and take on his assignment to track down a rare legendary animal. Use camouflage and scent masking to secure a clean harvest. Returns the unique pelt to Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Hunt down and collect all cards needed to finish 3 complete collectible card sets hidden across Leonida. Check convenience stores, apartments, and hidden nooks. Use an online collectible map to pin down missing cards efficiently.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK in-game scanning app to scan landmarks, buildings, and points of interest at 100 different locations. Start scanning early during story missions to save cleanup time. Track your tally in the collections menu.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 distinct gameplay challenges spanning combat, driving, stealth, and exploration. Check challenge criteria in the pause menu and tackle them naturally during your playthrough. Unlocks upon hitting the 50 milestone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Provoke a heavy 4-star police response while teamed up with your partner, then successfully hide out of sight until the search meter cools down. Utilize remote alleys or tunnels to shake pursuit.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hold up 3 different convenience stores in quick succession while with your partner, maintaining active police attention between robberies without clearing your wanted status. Move fast between nearby neighborhood shops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Spot and drive or scan 100 base-model vehicles across Leonida's streets and parking lots. Keep an eye out for uncommon cars and trucks as you explore. Check your automotive database in the pause menu.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus special ability during a firefight and eliminate 5 distinct enemies before the meter drains. Grouped enemies in story encounters or gang hideouts offer ideal conditions.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Execute a rapid, unplanned escape from the VCIA facility during operations. React quickly to security alarms and breach the perimeter under fire. Unlocks when the successful getaway registers.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Handle or disable military Rhino tanks during high-stakes confrontation sequences in the campaign. Use heavy explosives or tactical positioning to survive the armor assault. Unlocks upon overcoming the threat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Infiltrate a jewelry store, smash display cases, and escape with loot without alerting staff or triggering silent alarms. Use silenced weapons or stealth takedowns if necessary. Clean execution is key.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully crack and rob 5 major bank vaults across the state, shaking off the ensuing police pursuit each time. Leave the 8 large bank vaults until the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' for optimal setup. Escaping alive completes each heist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept a moving armored security truck on the highway, breach its doors with explosives, grab the cash sacks, and elude the police pursuit. A classic heist maneuver in free roam.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover and explore all 52 distinct regional areas across the map of Leonida. Travel through city districts, swamps, keys, and rural towns until the fog of war clears entirely on your pause menu map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Locate and raid an illegal stash house or operation belonging to each of the 9 rival gangs operating in Leonida. Overpower guards and loot their contraband reserves. Check off each gang faction one by one.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit Ocean Beach, sit down at a designated lounge or bar overlooking the coastline, and order a cocktail. The exact interaction spot is still being confirmed by the community, but visiting beachside watering holes in Vice City is the key. Unlocks once the drinking animation concludes.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a high-end vehicle from inside a car showroom and crash straight through the glass storefront windows to make a dramatic getaway. The precise showroom location is still being confirmed, but luxury dealership fronts in the city provide prime targets. Escape police attention afterward.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley establishment in Leonida and complete a full game of bowling. Line up your throw and execute a clean follow-through on the lanes. Unlocks upon finishing the match.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Trigger a special cooperative partnership event that gains widespread public attention. Coordinate activities with your partner in free roam until the milestone registers. Unlocks upon achieving mass appeal.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make narrative and interactive choices throughout missions and open-world encounters. PSN tracking monitors your cumulative decision count up to 500 actions. Unlocks naturally as you steer dialogue and event outcomes.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Retry a failed mission or activity attempt and succeed on your second try. The exact trigger conditions are still being confirmed by players, but failing and immediately succeeding on a reload handles this naturally. Unlocks upon success.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a bizarre paranormal or unexplained event in the wilds of Leonida. Specific coordinates and exact spawn conditions are still being confirmed by the community, but exploring remote swamps and desert fringes at night offers the best chance. Unlocks when the strange event plays out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Strike down a pedestrian or group using a melee weapon while riding past on a motorcycle or bicycle. The optimal technique and vehicle combinations are still being confirmed by players. Timing your swing from the saddle is essential.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Collect marked illegal bills from heists and crimes, then funnel them through your criminal contacts to successfully launder a cumulative total of $250,000. Check your laundering ledger progress in the safehouse network.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Purchase clothing, weapons, vehicle upgrades, and accessories at various retail shops across Leonida until you reach a cumulative spend of $100,000. Splurging on luxury items makes quick work of this.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy up all 8 garage and safehouse storage properties available for acquisition across the map. Save up cash from bank heists and robberies to fund the real estate investments. Unlocks upon purchasing the final garage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open up the in-game Scooter Bros mobile app and register 10 different vehicles into your personal fleet listing. Grab scooters, bikes, or compact cars off the street and log them through your phone. Unlocks at 10 registered vehicles.
